CROSSPOINT CARE

Here to serve

Crosspoint Care is a recently-formed ministry that focuses on helping our attendees and neighbors who need assistance. The Care Team is actively looking for volunteers willing to help with special requests, such as yardwork, transportation needs, cleaning, moving, small house projects, and babysitting. To see the full list of opportunities and to join the list of volunteers,  see the "Volunteer" button. 
Volunteer
request care

"The Crosspoint Care Team helped a lot. It's tough to be vulnerable and ask for help, but they were incredibly welcoming. It challenged me to see that some people do want to help, and I realized afterward how much I needed it. The whole experience showed me that God designed us to be brothers and sisters in community together that are there to help each other when they need it." - Joel

"You don't know how much of a blessing this is. I can't believe how many people have stepped in to help me. God has taught me a lot during this time. You all are amazing." - Brian
